text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the spring Tenno Sho on the<n>horizon and her
schedule as packed<n>as ever, Symboli Rudolf
attends to<n>another round of interviews.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the process, she announces the<n>academy's
first "Mega" Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Following Air Groove's collapse,<n>Symboli Rudolf
has been working like<n>a person possessed to
reassure<n>those around her that she can still be
relied upon.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her answer to her own perceived<n>shortcomings is
to work harder, run<n>faster, and show the world
that the<n>Emperor is flawless.
